behavioral_notes.observation: The single check-in/check-out toggle (models/hr_employee.py): if attendance_state != 'checked_in' it CREATES a new hr.attendance with check_in=now (and in_* geo fields), else it SEARCHes the open record (check_out=False) and WRITEs check_out=now (and out_* geo). If no open record is found on a check-out attempt it raises UserError. This create-or-close toggle is the heart of the subsystem and is invoked by every surface (kiosk barcode/PIN, systray, manual). Not visible in metadata.

worked_hours (stored, @api.depends check_in/check_out) is NOT a naive check_out-check_in delta: it localizes both times to the employee's resource.calendar timezone, then for non-flexible resources SUBTRACTS lunch intervals (employee._employee_attendance_intervals(..., lunch=True)) via Intervals algebra (sum_intervals). Flexible-calendar resources get the raw span. The formula lives in Python, not metadata.

Every create/write/unlink touching check_in/check_out/employee_id recomputes overtime: _update_overtime() deletes affected hr.attendance.overtime.line rows and regenerates them from the employee version's ruleset (rule_ids._generate_overtime_vals_v2 over the daily/weekly period), preserving manually-edited/to_approve lines, then schedules recompute of overtime_hours/expected_hours/validated_overtime_hours/overtime_status. A raw attendance edit cascades into a full overtime-line rebuild — a cross-model side-effect metadata cannot show.

attendance_state ('checked_in'/'checked_out') is computed from last_attendance_id: checked_in iff the latest attendance has no check_out. _compute_presence_state then OVERRIDES the generic HR presence (hr.employee.public also exposes attendance_state) so that a checked_in employee shows hr_presence_state='present' — attendance is wired as the 2nd-highest-priority presence signal after login. Cross-model behavior invisible in field metadata.

Public kiosk routes are token-gated by res.company.attendance_kiosk_key (HrAttendance._get_company) and run sudo: /attendance_barcode_scanned matches hr.employee.barcode, /manual_selection checks employee.pin when attendance_kiosk_use_pin, both call _attendance_action_change with a kiosk geoip stamp. Two crons also write attendances headlessly: _cron_auto_check_out closes forgotten open attendances past expected+tolerance hours (out_mode='auto_check_out'), and _cron_absence_detection inserts in_mode/out_mode='technical' 1-second attendances to book negative overtime for unjustified absences. Automation effects invisible in metadata.

13 JS files, 11 OWL components, 3 registry registrations (actions:employee_barcode_scanner, systray:hr_attendance.attendance_menu, views:attendance_list_view), 0 patches. The kiosk is a STANDALONE OWL App (kioskAttendanceApp in static/src/public_kiosk/public_kiosk_app.js) mounted by createPublicKioskAttendance via new App(...).mount(document.body) on the public website page (template hr_attendance.public_kiosk_mode) — it is NOT a backend client action; it bootstraps its own env/services and rpc's the public /hr_attendance/* JSON-RPC routes. Asset bundle hr_attendance.assets_public_attendance (30 assets) serves it; CheckInOut/BadgeScanner/KioskPinCode/KioskManualSelection/KioskGreetings drive barcode/PIN/manual flows, and ActivityMenu adds the backend systray check-in/out widget.

information_flows: side-effect: hr.attendance.create/write/unlink -> _update_overtime rebuilds hr.attendance.overtime.line from the ruleset
side-effect: hr.attendance state -> hr.employee.attendance_state -> hr_presence_state ('present' when checked in)
automation: _cron_auto_check_out closes forgotten attendances; _cron_absence_detection books technical absence attendances
integration: barcodes (badge scan) + base_geolocalize (base.geocoder reverse-geocode of check-in GPS/IP)

value_streams: Time-Capture: check-in -> open hr.attendance -> check-out -> worked_hours computed
Overtime-Settlement: attendance period -> overtime lines per ruleset -> approve/refuse -> validated extra hours
policies: 10 record rules: own-attendance read for base users; officer restricted to employees they manage (attendance_manager_id); multi-company scoping on hr.attendance and overtime lines
_check_validity / _check_validity_check_in_check_out: at most one open attendance, no overlapping slices, check_out >= check_in
write() guard: a non-manager may only edit their own attendances or those of employees they are the attendance manager of
res.company config: attendance_kiosk_use_pin, attendance_kiosk_mode, auto_check_out + tolerance, absence_management, attendance_device_tracking, overtime thresholds
stakeholders: HR / Payroll — consumes worked & validated overtime hours

classification.rationale: hr_attendance is an HR time-tracking SUPPORT activity (Stabell & Fjeldstad infrastructure/firm-infrastructure & HR management): it produces no saleable output and triggers no document chain into stock/account. It captures a labour-presence fact (the check-in/check-out event) and derives worked & overtime hours that feed downstream HR/payroll. Activity is support because it enables the workforce rather than creating customer value directly; the depends (hr core, barcodes for badge capture, base_geolocalize for GPS/IP stamping) are all enabling infrastructure, not value-flow links. APQC 7.0 (Develop and Manage Human Capital) — specifically the 'manage employee time/attendance' sub-process under workforce administration.

standard_capabilities: check-in/check-out via systray, manual entry, or public kiosk (barcode + optional PIN)
calendar- and lunch-aware worked-hours computation (flexible vs fixed schedules)
configurable overtime rulesets (daily/weekly, tolerances, rates) with approve/refuse validation
automatic check-out of forgotten attendances and technical absence detection (crons)
GPS/IP geolocation stamping of check-in/out (device tracking toggle, Google Maps link)
employee attendance_state driving HR presence; attendance reporting (pivot/graph)
typical_fits: badge/kiosk clock-in at a shared terminal per company (token-gated kiosk URL)
remote/desk workers self-checking via the backend systray widget
overtime approval workflow by an attendance officer scoped to their employees
common_gaps: integration with physical biometric/RFID hardware beyond barcode scan
country-specific overtime/labour-law rules not expressible in the standard ruleset
payroll posting of attendance/overtime hours (needs hr_payroll / work-entry bridge)
